title: Really rope you in
text: That first box was great, even if the cookies gave my dog diarrhea, definitely worth it. Cancel immediately after though. This second box came with one good toy that costs 15 dollars at Petco, an egg filled with bells my dog would easily choke on, some wipes that I could buy for 3 bucks on here, and 3 doggy cake pops that I'm sure will also give him diarrhea. First box, awesome. Second box, terrible ripoff
label: negative
